results.title: Ghana @ 70: InLaME CEO questions gains in leadership and institutional development
results.content: As Ghana prepares to mark 70 years of independence, concerns are mounting over whether the country has built the strong institutions and effective leadership needed to deliver sustainable development. Founder and CEO of the Institute of Leadership and Management in Education (InLaME), Nii Armah Addy, says the anniversary must trigger an honest national assessment of Ghana’s governance record rather than become another round of celebrations. He argues that despite decades of self-governance, persistent weaknesses in accountability, education and institutional effectiveness continue to undermine the country’s development ambitions. “As Ghana approaches seventy years of independence, we must ask ourselves some fundamental questions.
